faqSubtitle: Have questions about our services? Find the most common answers here.
faqA1: LSF (Light Steel Framing) is a construction system that uses galvanised light steel profiles as its structure. It is faster to assemble, lighter and offers excellent thermal and acoustic performance compared to traditional construction.
faqQ2: How long does it take to build an LSF home?
faqA2: The timeline for a turnkey house varies depending on the size of the home, the complexity of the project, the construction methods, the finishes chosen and other factors inherent to the build. In general, a turnkey house is completed within 8 to 12 months, from the start of construction to final handover. A detailed schedule is presented for each project, allowing the client to follow the progress of the work with complete transparency.
faqQ3: Do you handle projects and licensing?
faqA3: Yes. We develop the architectural and engineering project and manage the entire licensing process with local councils and other authorities, from start to finish.
faqA4: EE Engenharia develops its projects in the Greater Lisbon area and the South Bank, ensuring close supervision, rigorous site management and a high standard of quality at every stage of the project.
faqQ5: How can I get a quote?
faqA5: You can request a quote through the contact form, by email or by phone. After reviewing the details of your project, we will get in touch to gather the necessary information and present a proposal tailored to your needs.
faqA6: Yes, preparing quotes is completely free and without obligation.
faqA7: All work is carried out with certified materials and in accordance with current regulations. We offer a post-construction warranty and technical follow-up after delivery.
